metaDescription: Join the Best 5 Days Prenatal & Postnatal Yoga Teacher Training in Bali. Learn safe pregnancy yoga practices, postnatal recovery techniques, and earn an internationally recognized certification at Bali Yoga School.
summary: An introduction to Vedic Astrology (Jyotish Shastra) and the science of Numerology, conducted in the serene setting of Bali.
intro: At Bali Yoga School, our Astrology Course has been designed to take students beyond a surface-level understanding of the stars and into the deeper realms of cosmic intelligence, self-discovery, and spiritual insight. This course is conducted in the serene setting of Bali, and as a part of it, you get a real introduction to the Vedic Astrology or Jyotish Shastra as well as to the science of Numerology.

The consultations and course sessions are designed to blend the best of the ancient wisdom with the practical, so that the students can truly apply it to the real life situations that they face with greater confidence and clarity.
These sciences do not predict the future—they help students become more aware and intentional when making life choices.
At Bali Yoga School, this course is taught by an experienced Vedic Astrology teacher dedicated to sharing the ancient knowledge and timeless wisdom of these sciences.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Advance booking deposit is non-refundable. We accept date rescheduling for future batches. If you cancel the course after joining, we accept the cancellation, but the course fees will not be refunded.

policies.title: Management Authority
items: The management team is authorised to make the necessary changes in the daily schedule if needed.

policies.title: Course Booking & Confirmation
items: To book for the course, please deposit the complete course fees of 100 USD. An official confirmation letter for your program will be sent shortly after successful payment.

policies.title: Asanas Class
items: The purpose of the asana classes is to support your body and mind. These sessions promote personal well-being rather than provide professional-level training in asanas or alignment techniques.

policies.title: 1 Hour Self Practice
items: You can engage in a one-hour self-practice session in the HYA Healing Studio using available instruments. Any damage to equipment during practice must be covered by you.

policies.title: Important Note
items: The school reserves the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.

faqs.q: Do I need prior knowledge to join the Astrology Course?
faqs.a: No previous experience is needed. The course welcomes complete beginners as well as students who already have some knowledge of astrology.

faqs.q: What type of astrology is taught in this course?
faqs.a: The course focuses on Traditional Vedic Astrology (Jyotish Shastra), one of the oldest and most respected astrological systems in India.

faqs.q: What's the duration of the Astrology Course?
faqs.a: The course lasts 5 days and provides a focused introduction to Vedic Astrology.
No. This is a non-residential course and accommodation and meals are not included.

faqs.q: Will I be able to read my birth chart?
faqs.a: Yes. The course introduces birth chart interpretation so you can understand your own chart as well as others.

faqs.q: Is this course suitable for yoga students?
faqs.a: Yes. It is ideal for yoga practitioners, spiritual seekers and anyone interested in Vedic knowledge.
